scope: Components represented by the BGA implementation, including 5th-player content. Physical product completeness is listed separately from digital asset completeness.

digital_substitutions.physical: Main board with outer Glory track
digital_substitutions.bga: 1600x1600 RGBA province map; scores are shown in the player interface, so the physical outer track is absent.
Five assembled digital clan sheets using clan identity, troop cards, stat tracks and upgrade slots.
Digital panels and icons; these are not full scans of the physical sheets.
Two-dimensional illustrations and clan-colored figure tokens; no 3D model files.
Five unique reward types reused in quantities 1+3+2+2+1, with a digital pillaged state.

digital_substitutions.physical: Eight Ragnarök tokens and Doom token
digital_substitutions.bga: Province destruction/doom graphics, province material names and digital indicators.

digital_substitutions.physical: Plastic figure bases and physical markers
digital_substitutions.bga: Clan-colored digital outlines and interface markers; physical manufacturing geometry is not supplied.

notes: One image file per distinct face or digital variant does not imply one file per physical copy.
Card artwork is textless in the sprite. Complete card faces require the exact BGA text overlays from materials.json and templates.json.
Historical tutorial release 220513-1624 and current card sprite release 231218-1618 retain the same 151-cell order; all corresponding cells were compared and sample artwork was visually checked.
Current board and logo preserve alpha transparency. Current board is 1600x1600; current logo is 300x186.
